sloka: वालिनः पौरुषं यत्तद्यच्च वीर्यं धृतिश्च या ।तन्ममैकमनाश्श्रुत्वा विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम् ॥४-११-३॥।।
transliteration: vālinaḥ pauruṣaṁ yattadyacca vīryaṁ dhṛtiśca yā ।tanmamaikamanāśśrutvā vidhatsva yadanantaram ॥4-11-3॥।।

translations.english: Listen with single-minded attention as I tell of Vali's manliness, valour and fortitude, and then do what should be done thereafter.
